patterns.legacy: API keys / tokens page (create, reveal once, roll, revoke)
patterns.grammar: `pfkeys`: a `.dt` of keys with masked secrets, a REVEAL-ONCE dialog on creation (the secret is never re-shown), roll and revoke as row actions, the row drills to the key's panel

patterns.legacy: Team / members / seats page with invitations
patterns.grammar: `pfpeople`: ONE segmented collection (members + pending invitations), the invite composer in the FOOT, role as segments per row, owner-guarded destructive actions
`pfprojects`: rows carrying geography, retention and spend; create in the foot, archive from the detail
`pfbilling`: credit balance + auto-recharge in the body, sub-pages as DRILLS (payment methods, billing history) — the hub pattern, never tabs
`pfusage`: a range switcher as foot segments over one dataset, mono tabular figures, the chart is a block not a page
`pflimits`: threshold rows with inline edit, the alert address as a field, never a modal
`pflogs`: append-only mono scrollback with level colours, a line drills to its error context
`pfhealth`: component rows with state dots (accent ramp, never green), incident history as drills
`pfsecurity`: posture rows with a state per control; the evidence drills out of the row
`pfcontrols`: switch rows with their consequence written beside them, saved on flip
`pfimages`: a density-switchable gallery, the item drills to its detail panel
`pfprompt`: the config column becomes stacked sections, model and options are SEGMENTS (never native selects), the composer is anchored in the FOOT
`pfterm`: mono scrollback in the body, the PROMPT in the foot, ArrowUp history, verbs drive the workspace through the bridge
`pfchat`: the thread IS the panel body, the composer is the foot, slash commands speak the bridge
`pfrealtime`: the live session as a panel, its controls in the foot
`pfhub`: paste-ready recipes as rows, each drilling into the prefilled composer
`report`: the funnel is a BLOCK in the body; a step drills the lost or passed cohort
`report`: sources as rows with tabular figures; a source drills its detail
`report`: one dataset, the segment drills; the numbers stay mono tabular
`report`: the projection block plus its assumptions as rows the reader can inspect
